.. change::
    :tags: change, general
    :tickets: 1851

    Support for SQLAlchemy 1.4 is dropped as of Alembic 1.20.0; SQLAlchemy
    2.0.0 is now the minimum required version.  SQLAlchemy 1.4 has no support
    for Python 3.13 and above, and the version-conditional code paths it
    required throughout Alembic have been removed in favor of the SQLAlchemy
    2.0 API.
